newsList.title: PS4/PS5 Leaderboard Restructuring
newsList.body:
The PS4 and PS5 versions of Sly 2 have been patched, removing the ability to skip cutscenes by pressing start (Universal Cutscene Skip / UCSS).

Since v1.0 is inaccessible on a PS5, we have **moved all v1.0 runs performed on a PS5 to a Legacy board** stored on the Category Extensions page. That boar

categories.name: Any% w/ cheats
categories.rules:
Beat the game as fast as possible. All cheat codes are allowed. This is a "New Game"-speedrun, meaning the speedrun begins from a completely blank save file with no stored data.

Timing starts when Sly first takes out his Binocucom (first white flash) and ends after pressing Circle to get the Hate Chip as Bentley.

Video proof is required for this category.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
# **Objective**

Beat the episode as fast as possible.

# **Objective**

Beat the episode as fast as possible while collecting all thirty bottles and opening the vault.

levels.name: Episode 1
levels.rules:
# Timing

Timing starts when exiting safe house for the first time and ends when the final input connects to finish off Dimitri.

# Gadgets

You may use any gadget during the run that is available at the start of the episode. Gadgets may be purchased before or during the run.

In addition to purchasable gadgets you can use the gadget obtained from the Episode 1 vault.

No gadgets can be equipped to any buttons before starting the run.

*List of the gadgets allowed for each episode: [https://www.speedrun.com/posts/q8scd](https://www.speedrun.com/posts/q8scd)*

# Video evidence

Video evidence is required when claiming a Top 5 time or a time among Top 40 % of the total amount of leaderboard placements. See video requirements under game rules.

values.name: Classic
values.rules:
# **Objective**



Beat the game with 100% file completion as fast as you can. This means collecting all thirty bottles and opening the vault in all eight episodes. This is a “New Game”-speedrun, meaning the speedrun begins from a completely blank save file with no stored data.



> Achieving 100% completion also requires completing Cairo in a single instance without skipping any triggers or cutscenes on your way to the end of the tutorial level. Trigger that brings the van to its end destination with back doors open involving a voice line by Murray is the final trigger required to hit before the level ending trigger in order to get the needed percentage completion for the prologue.



# **Timing**



Timing starts when Sly first takes out his Binocucom (first white flash) and ends when the circle input to get Hate Chip as Bentley connects.



# **Video evidence**



Video proof is required for this category. See video requirements under game rules.

*I ran into some major user error with livesplit during EP6. After further analysis of my technical difficulties I've deduced that my headphone cable hit my reset key causing livesplit prompt me to 'save best splits' which in turn caused livesplit to act unresponsively/freeze. (this also caused some layout issues but I don't believe my game feed was ever obstructed) I would have been able to fix this simply by pressing cancel and the timer would have resumed. Unfortunately the window prompting me to save my best splits popped up on my main monitor which is on a different input. So I had no clue that I could have fixed it until the run was over. Unfortunately I felt this affect my mindset and caused me to lose focus. (copium) Next time I will take precautions to make sure I avoid any more technical difficulties.

# **Objective**



Beat the game with 100% file completion as fast as you can. This means collecting all thirty bottles and opening the vault in all eight episodes. This is a “New Game”-speedrun, meaning the speedrun begins from a completely blank save file with no stored data.



> Achieving 100% completion also requires completing Cairo in a single instance without skipping any triggers or cutscenes on your way to the end of the tutorial level. Trigger that brings the van to its end destination with back doors open involving a voice line by Murray is the final trigger required to hit before the level ending trigger in order to get the needed percentage completion for the prologue.



# **Timing**



Timing starts when Sly first takes out his Binocucom (first sign of camera angle changing) and ends when the circle input to get Hate Chip as Bentley connects.



# **Video evidence**



Video proof is required for this category. See video requirements under game rules.
